==Categorization==
*[[:Category:Project Stardust]]

==Usage==
To use this template, insert {{Tl|Stardust}} to the top of the article. The &#124;title= field should be used if the project page has a different title to the article name. Parameters should then be used to specify issues:
*<nowiki>image=1</nowiki>
*<nowiki>update=[[Page to update with]], [[Page to update with]]</nowiki>
*<nowiki>cleanup=1</nowiki>
*<nowiki>expand=1</nowiki>
*<nowiki>tense=1</nowiki>
*<nowiki>npov=1</nowiki>
*<nowiki>citation=1</nowiki>
*<nowiki>redlink=1</nowiki>

==Example==
<nowiki>{{Stardust|image=1|cleanup=1|expand=1|tense=1|npov=1|citation=1|redlink=1|update=[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]], [[Ahsoka (novel)|Ahsoka]], [[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]], and {{FactFile2014|18|AHS 1-4|Ahsoka Tano}}}}</nowiki> creates

{{Stardust|image=1|cleanup=1|expand=1|tense=1|npov=1|citation=1|redlink=1|update=[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]], [[Ahsoka (novel)|Ahsoka]], [[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]], and {{FactFile2014|18|AHS 1-4|Ahsoka Tano}}}}
